title: When will AI take my job? — the timeline
description: Every profession on willaistealit.com plotted against the year its core tasks are expected to be machine-done. 15 horizons, from 2028 onward.
h2: These years are estimates, and they are meant to be argued with

jsonLd.description: As of August 2026, 15 of the 17 professions on willaistealit.com carry a time horizon — the year by which their core tasks are expected to be routinely machine-done. Those horizons run from 2028 to 2035, and 2030 is the most crowded year with 4 professions. The remaining 2 are judged safe and carry no horizon at all.
jsonLd.name: AI job replacement timeline
jsonLd.variableMeasured: Year by which a profession's core tasks are expected to be routinely machine-done
